risk_assessment.rationale: Time-pressure to pay today via an external card link is the main risk, though no bank-detail change or executive impersonation is present. Without corroboration this warrants verification before payment.

signals.explanation: Subject creates same-day deadline pressure to settle.

signals.explanation: Requests immediate payment by card through an external link, with threat of a late fee if not done today.
signals.quote: To avoid a late fee, please settle the balance today by card at https://pay.fmr-supplies.example/ashgrove.

skeptic.argument: The sender domain fmr-supplies.example matches the payment link domain pay.fmr-supplies.example, the message is addressed to accounts@ashgrovebakery.example with a specific GBP 482.60 balance, and it comes from a named supplier rather than an executive impersonation attempt. Urgency to avoid a late fee and a request to pay by card are normal collection practices and by themselves do not show deception. No facts in our records contradict Fennimore Stationery being a legitimate vendor owed this amount.
skeptic.evidence_that_would_change_my_mind: Call Fennimore Stationery on a phone number already on file (not from this email) and ask whether they sent this overdue notice and whether pay.fmr-supplies.example/ashgrove is their official payment page for GBP 482.60.
